title: Quantitative Liver Functions in Turner Syndrome With and Without Hormone Replacement Therapy
brief_summary: Several studies have demonstrated that Turner Syndrome patients have elevated liver enzymes readily suppressible by a short course of HRT. We wanted to estimated quantitative liver functions in a young group of Turner syndrome patients compared to a healthy control group.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Turner syndrome by karyotype

Exclusion Criteria:

* Thyroid abnormality
* Glucocorticoid treatment
